## Problem

What concrete user problem does this change solve?

## Behavioral change

What will the skill do differently, and what will it still refuse to do?

## Validation

- [ ] `python3 scripts/validate_repo.py` passes.
- [ ] `claude plugin validate . --strict` passes, or Claude Code was unavailable locally.
- [ ] Examples and expected outputs match the files actually shipped.
- [ ] I used only synthetic or fully redacted test data.
- [ ] I added no secret, credential or private customer data.
- [ ] File-writing behavior is local, run-specific and collision-safe.
- [ ] Counts, license terms and product claims remain consistent.
